name: permission-gate
description: Bash whitelist gate: non-whitelisted commands require interactive approval. Timeout behavior and the whitelist are configurable via /settings → Plugins.

approvalTimeout.description: How non-whitelisted commands are handled. 30s: prompt, auto-reject after 30s of silence (default). immediate: block instantly without prompting — use when away from the keyboard. forever: prompt and wait until you answer — use when at the keyboard.

whitelist.description: Comma-separated command prefixes allowed without approval. Replaces the built-in whitelist when non-empty; leave empty to use the built-in list. Command-substitution and non-scratch redirect guards still apply.
